HALF CLOSED, AND THE HALF THAT REMAINS IS NAMED IN THE FACT ITSELF.

CLOSED — the reachability half. Its sharpest instance is fixed: `where-am-i` now has a step 3 telling the agent to lead with the delivery line, so the number it already gathered gets said. And the class is pinned: every served `*_report` must be named in a skill or carry a written reason, checked in CI, observed failing first at six of fourteen.

🛑 NOT CLOSED — the fact's own last paragraph: "whether the five zero-mention reports are actually UNUSED in the field, or merely unmentioned. Naming was measured; invocation was not." That is exactly as open as it was. Routing makes a report reachable, not read, and the 93-session skill-adoption measurement says what predicts use is an ALWAYS-INJECTED surface — which a skill is not. A later count of whether these reports are now invoked is the measurement that would close it, and nobody has taken it.

⚠️ ALSO STILL OPEN, and it is the more interesting one: the fact questions whether `Delivered: N of M` is the right headline for a USER's project at all, since it is computed from the thread and so measures whether the design's own chain is complete rather than whether the system works. Step 3 now states that bound in words rather than resolving it.
